Chilliwack Proper East: streets and boundaries

items.t: Chilliwack Proper East is the eastern half of Chilliwack Proper, the older urban grid north of the Vedder River in the City of Chilliwack.

The City does not plan this ground under its board name: it sits inside Schedule B2, the Chilliwack Proper and Fairfield Island Neighbourhoods Plan, of the 2050 Official Community Plan (Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500).
Yale Road is the east–west spine, with Chilliwack Middle School at 46354 Yale Road and Chilliwack Secondary at 46363 Yale Road on it.
Highway 1 (Trans-Canada Highway) access for this side of the city is at the Prest Road interchange, Exit 123.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper East: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A suite here must sit above the flood construction level: the City's small-scale multi-unit housing guide states new secondary suites are not permitted below the flood construction level.

One accessory dwelling unit is permitted per lot under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000: a secondary suite is capped at the lesser of 90 square metres and 40 percent of the building's habitable floor space, and garden suites are capped at 100 square metres (sections 2, 4.06 and 5.04).

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper East: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The two Yale Road schools sit almost opposite each other: Chilliwack Middle School is at 46354 Yale Road and Chilliwack Secondary at 46363 Yale Road, so school traffic shapes Yale Road at start and finish times.

A suite is only legal if it was built with a building permit meeting the British Columbia Building Code and Fire Code and current flood protection requirements — ask for the permit on any existing suite here.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper East: costs and taxes

items.t: One date matters for summer closings here: City property taxes are due the first working day after July 1, with a 5 percent penalty on taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and a further 5 percent after August 4, 2026.
BC Transit runs Chilliwack transit, and Downtown Chilliwack is the exchange for local routes 51 to 59, 71 and 72.
Route 57 Broadway is this area's east–west bus, and since January 4, 2026 it runs on McNaught Road instead of Carleton Street, with new stops on McNaught Road and Acorn Street.
Route 66 Fraser Valley Express is the regional link, running from Downtown Chilliwack toward Lougheed Town Centre Station.

blocks.text: Chilliwack Proper East: risks and due diligence

items.t: Flood level is the first check on any lot here: Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 sets the buildable floor at the flood construction level plus 0.6 metres of freeboard for new development in the floodplain.
Which Schedule D permit areas touch a specific Proper East parcel is a per-parcel check with the City — the plan lists D-1 Drinking Water Supply through D-10 Industrial.
